body: yellow fertilizer crystals fill the seam between the wax crayons and animal-feed sack. the crystals are damp beneath a dry outer layer.
title: After on the wax crayons, the first copy
gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
